# `jouet plugin rm`

- **Usage:** `jouet plugin rm [--repo] <NAME>`

Unpin a plugin

## Arguments
- **`<NAME>`** — The plugin's name

## Flags
- **`--repo`** — Unpin it from this repository's .jouet/plugins.toml rather than yours
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
